title.rendered: Board of Directors Executive Session – May 1, 2024

content.rendered: The SSD Board of Directors will meet in an Executive Session on Wednesday, May 1, 2024 under ORS 192.660(2)(a) – Personnel. Please see the link below for official meeting notice. Please note that Executive Sessions are closed to the public as per Oregon statute.
